services.desc: WE ARE EXCITED TO OFFER OVERNIGHT AND DAY CAMP OPPORTUNITIES FOR CHILDREN AGES 6-17 IN LANCASTER OHIO Embark on a journey of outdoor exploration at Geneva Hills! This immersive summer experience promises a perfect blend of thrilling activities and enriching spiritual growth for children and teenagers. Join us in the heart of Ohio’s Hocking Hills for an unforgettable adventure where campers interact with Christ and His nature. Our caring and experienced staff are dedicated to creating a safe, nurturing environment.
